name: number_word
description: Write a small integer (0-20) as an English number word, few-shot. Control: same format but answer is the digits repeated.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
w=['zero','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine','ten','eleven','twelve','thirteen','fourteen','fifteen','sixteen','seventeen','eighteen','nineteen','twenty']
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    shots=random.sample(range(0,21),3); q=random.choice([x for x in range(0,21) if x not in shots])
    p=''.join(f"Digits: {a}\nWord: {w[a]}\n\n" for a in shots)+f"Digits: {q}\nWord:"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+w[q]})
    p2=''.join(f"Word: {w[a]}\nDigits: {a}\n\n" for a in shots)+f"Word: {w[q]}\nDigits:"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":f" {q}"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
